name: CalculiX FEA FB
description:
Parallel FEA material sweep using CalculiX. Submit your model once and simultaneously solve for multiple materials — each running as an independent job on the cluster. Automatically generates an engineering report with bar charts comparing Young's Modulus, Yield Strength, Density, Poisson's Ratio, and Specific Stiffness across all materials, plus highlighted recommendations for best stiffness, best strength, lightest weight, and best stiffness-to-weight ratio. Designed for mechanical engineers evaluating material selection for structural components.

fuzzball workflow list

fuzzball workflow describe <id number>

fuzzball workflow port-forward <id number> serve 8080:8080

http://localhost:8080/
